name: ACC Pet Food Pantry
notes: ACC's pet food pantry for owners who are struggling to feed their pets. Its page on ACC's site gives the details; email CommunityPets@nycacc.org or ring (212) 788-4000 before you travel, to check what is available and where. The city's 22 community pet food pantries are listed separately.
